note: InProcess toolchain required: WPF Application + Window creation needs COM STA initialization. BDN default out-of-process toolchain spawns a new MTA process which fails PresentationSource type initialization. Benchmark runs on a dedicated STA thread (WpfStaHost static singleton). All WPF work dispatched via Dispatcher.Invoke from BDN measurement thread. Batch design: WindowShowHideProxy posts 50 Show/Hide pairs per Dispatcher.Invoke call (4 BDN ops per measurement = 200 Show/Hide pairs per iteration). CPU pinned to core 0.

methods.name: WindowShowHideProxy
methods.note: cv=2.85% — 50 Window.Show+Hide pairs per Dispatcher.Invoke call; warm HWND path (HWND pre-created in GlobalSetup). Per Show/Hide = ~5.3ms including Win32 WM_SHOWWINDOW + WM_ACTIVATE + WM_PAINT round-trip. All four Application.Run* entries proxy-only (100% of their CPU cost inherited from Dispatcher.PushFrameImpl); Show->Hide is the closest runnable warm-steady-state surface.

methods.name: WindowShowDialog
methods.note: cv=16.1% — consistently > 10% across two run sets (first: 9.6%, second: 16.1%). Root cause: EnumThreadWindows + EnableThreadWindows(false/true) over all thread windows + ComponentDispatcher.PushModal() nested frame adds scheduling jitter. Single-frame modal pump (pre-enqueued BeginInvoke close at Send priority) does not eliminate bimodal variance from Win32 EnableWindow(HWND[]) walk. Added to bench-skipped.tsv. Fix: isolate ShowDialog in its own process with no other windows (no thread-window list to walk); or split EnumThreadWindows cost via perf test harness.

methods.name: NegativeControlDispatcherInvoke
methods.note: cv=1.67% — pure Dispatcher.Invoke cross-thread round-trip with empty body. Establishes lower bound: the ~126us difference between this and WindowShowHideProxy (~5.3ms/op) represents Win32 ShowWindow + WM_ACTIVATE + WM_PAINT overhead (~5.2ms per Show/Hide pair). Note: UpdateLayout rejected as negative control due to bimodal behavior (clean-layout no-op vs first-dirty path); Dispatcher.Invoke no-op is a stable, non-degenerate baseline.
